title: Finite graph crossing and actual downstream drainage form a conditional synthesis rule
statement: A finite normal mode/packet policy counts each actual raw channel ONCE and makes normal transitions neutral at one proper z. Positive reference coefficients must be acquired by finite raw background balance,with every signed physical boundary included. For weighted mode edges,phi(target)-phi(source)>=1_B-K 1_G exists iff no positive weighted directed cycle;longest-path relaxation constructs phi or a cycle obstruction. This permits interacting loops without a total source ordering. Actual absorption/physical time,adjoint occupation,reference barrier and raw hazard comparisons must then be PROVED,not supplied as a gap/profile/oracle. The productive-exit rule matches P_B<=C_B P_A and neutral exits to activation,so P_G+P_A>=p_*>0. Personally constructed continuations at the SAME z must pay every failure with fixed drainage -L d+o(1),bounded final increments and mean O(z^s). Choose fixed L to pay debt,then integer p>=max(2,s+1) and a scalar multiplier make U=D z^p pay actual physical time;quadratic suffices for s=1. All outside states must eventually be covered at that SAME receiver for global recurrence. Neither a general normal-policy finder nor arbitrary-network reference/activation/coverage acquisition is proved.

requires: Two ordered degree-seven blocks 0→AB→2A+B+C→3A+2B+2C→0 and 0→DE→2D+E+F→3D+2E+2F→0,all block rates fixed positive;conservative A+D+2B+2C↔A+D+2E+2F at rates2,1. Ordinary falling-factorial propensities without factorial divisors.

Each operation uses its proved input region and actual stopping/output class at U=D Z^2,Z=15+|x|-m(A)-m(D),m=(0,2,4,7,7,...). Small relative pair-difference cone is essential for the unbounded launch/terminal ports.
provides: Exact statement above, at the stated contract.
costs: Charge actual physical holding times,all interruptions/endpoints,normal-cell/finite-kernel acquisition and receiver increments. O(N) mean physical episode time differs from jump activity. General policy/reference/barrier/coverage acquisition and numerical threshold constants are not supplied free.
contract.units: Elapsed physical time,actual endpoint reward,genuine jumps,stationary activity,return moments and exponential return are separate quantities. No physical chemistry operation inferred.
contract.obstruction: Same-principal source proofs,not an independent audit. High anchors,signed packet residuals,large pair differences and arbitrary-list policy acquisition remain open. No full six-species or unrestricted recurrence,exponential return,practical advantage or novelty claim. Chemistry non-operational.
